description: Asrai's own indicator signals across the whole market from the last N days (default 3): SuperALSAT (1D ALSAT confirmed by a 4H AlphaTrend — the strongest reversal signal), ALSAT, AlphaTrend, SuperTD9, TD9, TD13 — coin, buy/sell, timeframe, date, age in days, price at the signal. Newest first. Use for: 'fresh buy signals', 'what triggered recently', 'new ALSAT/TD9 signals', or as setup candidates (then coin_brief / trade_plan). A signal alone is not a trade — check structure and R:R.
name: fresh_signals
